requirements.text: Students should have the ability to color-code modules in their timetables.
Students should be able to add personal study blocks to their timetables.
Students should be able to hide canceled classes in their timetables.
Students should be able to export or sync their personalized timetables with external calendar applications.
The system should send immediate notifications for newly posted grades.
Notifications for newly posted grades should be delivered via app notifications, email, and SMS.
Students should have the option to customize their notification preferences for grades and deadlines.
The system should send reminders for upcoming assignment deadlines and exam dates a few days in advance.
The feedback system should allow students to rate key aspects of the module experience and provide comments.
The feedback should focus on content quality, instructor effectiveness, and resource availability.
The feedback system must ensure anonymity for student responses.
Feedback should be collected after the teaching period ends.
Feedback results should only be made available to coordinators after grades are finalized.
The system must comply with GDPR and data retention policies.
